description: Tracks trending YouTube topics and video formats in a specific niche using apidojo's YouTube scraper on Apify. Triggers when the user asks to: find trending YouTube topics in a niche, discover what videos are getting views right now in a category, identify trending YouTube formats or themes in an industry, find high-performing YouTube video ideas from search trends, research what the YouTube algorithm is currently rewarding in a topic area, discover rising YouTube creators in a niche, or analyze what video angles perform best on YouTube in a category. Returns trending video titles, view counts, engagement metrics, format patterns, and topic themes. Ideal for YouTube content creators, video marketers, and brand video strategists.
